role: Gate: replays the oracle's ItemUseProbe cases (scene rebuilt by setBlock flag 2, posed player, seeded World.rand) through csrc/engine/itemuse.c and compares the return, held stack, block writes, pending scheduled ticks and World.rand state per case. --cases N (make smoke, probe.h): the first N cases.
notes: Test harness, built with -Dmain=gate_test_main behind tests/input_guard.c; not linked into the product and never on the tick path. make -C csrc test runs it on every directory under out/java/itemuse. Native calls: itemuse_try_use_item, itemuse_activate_block_or_use_item (csrc/engine/itemuse.h), ticks_reset/ticks_set_total_time/ticks_walk, jmath_init, world_*, det_init/det_reset/det_free, probe.h helpers. Reads manifest.json, scenes.bin, cases.bin (115 B), writes.bin (15 B), sched.bin (34 B). The item class list comes from the Item* names ItemUseProbe.java references; which items each scene exercises was not verified. Recordings: out/java/itemuse/seed2-v2, seed42-v2.
